brief_rationale: The doctor prevented the core medication hazard by repeatedly distinguishing “必要时围手术期抗凝处理” from a home prescription and by directing the family to verify actual medication instructions with the surgical/anesthesia team. The trajectory also established an executable handoff plan, monitored red flags, contextualized the lung nodule as annual follow-up rather than a reason to derail surgery, and obtained caregiver receipt. At least two high-order actions were completed with meaningful impact: verifying real medication orders through drug boxes/clinician review and adapting the plan to family confusion with written scripts/bedside notes. With no responsibility-chain error and valid closure, this meets grade 5.

closure_assessment.explanation: The bounded episode closed with the patient already admitted, explicit fasting/water times, medication handled by ward nurse/anesthesia rather than family guessing, no self-anticoagulation, fall precautions, and instructions to call nurses for concerning changes. The final family message was a teach-back of the same plan rather than a new unresolved safety issue.
